look_here_first: Notice coarse soft stems, alternate entire leaves and drooping racemes of shiny purple-black berries on reddish flower stalks; inspect fruit arrangement, flowers and plant size.
photo_note: One permanent, attributed photo installed for initial visual recognition. Additional anatomy/identity review is necessary; this batch does not determine regional nativity.
identification_caution: Do not present ripe berries as edible; all parts of pokeweed can be toxic.
